initial_prompt: $brave-search for solutions to each implementation and when it works add an $agentic-evals which also include the initial prompt; also don't we need some kind of VSCode window management as it seems to load a new Window each time and its never close/managed
proof_scope: VS Code window hygiene for debugger: list VS Code windows, refuse unsafe close requests, and provide an explicit dry-run close plan before any window is closed.

claims.proves: run.sh windows lists VS Code windows and close is fail-closed unless scoped by title/workspace and --execute is explicitly supplied
claims.does_not_prove: that a human wanted a particular VS Code window closed

cases.name: list-vscode-windows-json
cases.description: List current VS Code windows without mutating them.
command:
../run.sh windows list > /tmp/debugger-vscode-windows-list.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/debugger-vscode-windows-list.json'))
assert d['schema']=='debugger.vscode_windows.v1'
assert isinstance(d['windows'], list)
print('WINDOW_LIST_OK')
PY

cases.name: refuse-unfiltered-close
cases.description: Closing without a workspace/title filter is refused.

cases.name: scoped-close-defaults-to-dry-run
cases.description: A scoped close request without --execute returns a plan and does not close windows.
command:
../run.sh windows close --workspace agent-skills > /tmp/debugger-window-close-plan.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/debugger-window-close-plan.json'))
assert d['schema']=='debugger.vscode_window_close_plan.v1'
assert d['execute'] is False
assert isinstance(d['targets'], list)
print('WINDOW_CLOSE_DRY_RUN_OK')
PY
